title: The Clever Fox
text:
Once there was a fox in a forest. He was always hungry. One day he saw a crow sitting in a tree with a piece of cheese.

The fox said, 'What a beautiful voice you have! Please sing for me.' The proud crow opened her mouth to sing, and the cheese fell down. The fox ate the cheese and ran away.

questions.text: What fell down when the crow opened her mouth?
Why did the fox say the crow had a beautiful voice?
options: He wanted to hear a song only.
He wanted to sleep in the tree.

questions.text: What is the best lesson of the story?
options: Do not trust people who say nice words only to get something.

paragraph_translations: Dawno temu w lesie mieszkał lis. Zawsze był głodny. Pewnego dnia zobaczył wronę, która siedziała na drzewie z kawałkiem sera.
Lis powiedział: 'Jaki piękny masz głos! Proszę, zaśpiewaj dla mnie.' Dumna wrona otworzyła dziób, żeby zaśpiewać, i ser spadł na ziemię. Lis zjadł ser i uciekł.
